documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our wholesale distribution team requested discovery about fragmented reporting. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves 'fragmented reporting' as noted in their inquiry, and there is a contradiction in the project status—earlier interest in discovery versus the latest call indicating the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. This requires clarification before moving forward.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our wholesale distribution team requested discovery about fragmented reporting.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your team previously requested discovery about fragmented reporting, but the latest call indicates the project is paused and there is disagreement about the requirement. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current status of the project and the specific concerns around the reporting requirements?
questions: Could you clarify the current status of the project and whether the team is still interested in exploring solutions for fragmented reporting?
What specific aspects of the reporting are causing friction, and are there any particular systems or data sources involved?
uncertainties: The contradiction between the earlier interest in discovery and the current project pause needs resolution.
The exact nature of the disagreement with the project requirement is unclear.
